intent: Cover transcribe_venv.sh to a measured 100% and take it off the allowlist -- the second removal this session, 104 -> 103.
scope: Non-goal: no change to the subject; no latent bug surfaced
changes: Assertions are on RECORDED ARGV because which index a pip install points at IS the behaviour here: the OpenNMT cu12 wheel index on the NVIDIA path, and the CPU-only torch index for diarization (forced to avoid mismatched CUDA builds). A 'pip was called' check cannot see either.

generate_test_audio's four-deep fallback chain (espeak-ng -> espeak -> Python stdlib -> ffmpeg) is covered by failing each generator in turn. Each stub MATERIALISES the wav, because the chain advances on `[[ ! -s $tmpwav ]]` -- a record-only stub would silently exercise the next branch instead of the one under test.

The four `|| log "Warning: ..."` pip-failure paths are covered with a python stub that always exits 1. An initial assertion that the function still returns 0 was WRONG and was corrected rather than forced: the final `python "$PY_HELPERS" deps-installed` has no `|| log`, so a wholly-failing python does make it return non-zero. The suite now asserts what the subject actually guarantees -- all four warnings are emitted and no earlier failure aborts the run.
SC2016 was fixed at the source by switching the failing-pip stub to a quoted heredoc, not suppressed.

verification.command: bash meta/scripts/check_shell_coverage.sh .../transcribe_venv.sh (AFTER removing the allowlist entry)
verification.evidence: 'every checked shell library meets the coverage bar'. The real gate accepts it with no exemption.
15 + 18 + 29 + 18 = 80 assertions, 0 failures across all four suites in the directory.

risks: The suite stubs python/python3 heavily. If the subject later stops routing work through $PY_HELPERS the stubs would keep passing while testing nothing -- the assertions are on argv, so a changed argv fails loudly, but a REMOVED call would not.

generate_test_audio's chain depends on each stub writing a non-empty file. A future stub that forgets to would move the test to a different branch than its name claims, the same failure mode this suite exists to avoid.
rollback: git revert the commit; transcribe_venv.sh returns to the allowlist and loses its suite.
After rollback, confirm the allowlist is back to 104 entries.
